summary: Lawrence is detained and questioned by a young Securitat man in a monitored interview room. He lies about his purpose, claiming he is trying to find an Order member who left and that the Order wants him back, while concealing the zbigkrot data tampering and the disappearance of Anja Krotoski. The Securitat man says there is no record of Krotoski and advises Lawrence to go home and forget about him, which Lawrence reads as a sign that Zbigniew Krotoski has been erased. The excerpt ends with the Securitat man telling Lawrence to adjust the settings on his pan.
one_line: Lawrence, questioned by a Securitat officer, lies about his mission and is warned to forget the vanished Krotoski.
key_facts: Lawrence is shackled to a plastic chair bolted into the floor while a Securitat man uses a check-in kiosk.
The CCTV cameras are huge, seemingly throwbacks to an earlier era, and are meant to let people know they are being watched.
The Securitat man rolls up his mask so Lawrence can see his face, which is young and hard.
The Securitat man was in diapers when Lawrence went into the Order.
Lawrence lies to the Securitat man rather than telling him about zbigkrot tampering with Securitat data-streams or the disappearance of Anja Krotoski.
Lawrence tells the Securitat man he is looking for an Order member who took his leave, and that the Order wants to talk to him about coming back.
Lawrence claims he has been trying to locate zbigkrot by following up on his old contacts and expects to find him within a day or two.
Lawrence implies he is crucial to the Order and works for the Securitat all the time, on the same team.
The Securitat man touches an earbead from time to time, and someone else is listening and feeding him material.
The Securitat man says, "We don't have any record of this Krotoski person," and advises, "I advise you to go home and forget about him."
The Securitat man's words are said without any inflection, which Lawrence finds the scariest part.
Lawrence concludes there are no records of Krotoski because Zbigniew Krotoski was erased.
Lawrence replies, "Thank you for telling me so," and says, "I appreciate the advice."
The Securitat man tells Lawrence, "You need to adjust the settings on your pan."
